scope: Workflow permission guidance, typed context selection and current-identity component state. Software tests use isolated artificial records only. Browser, persistent-data and publication verification are separate.
implemented: Server capability role lists are the sole preparation UI input; no local fallback
Pending, failed, malformed and missing role lists keep affected controls disabled; explicit empty lists remain truthful unavailable-role states
Readable adjacent current-role handoff with aria-describedby and keyboard-accessible tool-input details
Form and request state retire on tenant, actor, role or token change
The sharing workflow can select its required saved schedule; unrelated scopes retain their existing record kinds
All new handoff and prerequisite body text uses 12px minimum type and explicit line height

backend_reference.sharing_context: One scoped schedule with assignments and input aircraft/mission snapshots; country coordination input must match its current scoped mission and organisation

preserved_failures.result: Two suites failed before test collection because the aliased working root did not resolve /src files; canonical real working directory used subsequently
14 passed, 1 failed. Isolated invalid-role fixture used it.each array spreading; invalid row values now wrapped and explicit valid empty role list tested separately
Repeated pre-repair fixture failure after a patch helper ran from the wrong working directory; exact receipt preserved. Correct root applied the repair before the successful focused run

checks: Identity key is stable for unchanged actor context and retires local state at identity changes
Components are defined at module scope
Native disabled buttons preserve server enforcement and explanatory text sits outside disabled controls
Capability lookup is bounded to the existing typed GET and retry does not start workflows
No dependency, animation, network egress or aviation command changes

limitations: No real browser or operational acceptance is inferred from component tests
Application version and backend tests are coordinated separately by the parent
No original requirement status was upgraded by this change
